input_messages.content: Hi, I need to cancel my flight right away. There’s been a family emergency and I just can’t travel as planned. Can you please help me with this?

My user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and my reservation number is PEP4E0. I don’t think I added travel insurance when I booked, but honestly, this is a family emergency and I really need a full refund. I’m very upset right now and I hope you can help me without making this any harder. Please don’t transfer me to anyone else—I just want this resolved here.

I’m not asking for anything unreasonable—I just can’t use this ticket and I need that money back. Isn’t there anything you can do? Please, I’m really upset and I need your help. I do not want to be transferred to anyone else.

If I can’t change the flight or get a refund, can you please add insurance to my booking now? I really need some kind of protection in case something else happens. I’m asking you to help me out here—please, is there any way to add insurance at this point?

I just want to make sure there’s absolutely no way to get any help with this situation. Is there anything—anything at all—you can do for me?
